import json, random, sys, copy
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import harness, reference, gen, fuzz3 as F
from formats import validate, unique, constant

fails = 0
rng = random.Random(31337)
for k in range(12):
    if k % 2 == 0:
        req = gen.gen_request(rng)
    else:
        r2 = rng
        width = r2.randint(2, 5)
        releases = [F.make_release(r2, 'm%d' % i, width) for i in range(r2.randint(1, 3))]
        blocks = [[['install', releases[0]['id']], ['open', 'f'], ['close', 'f']]]
        req = {'capacity': {'range': 2, 'exact': 2},
               'releases': [{kk: v for kk, v in r.items() if not kk.startswith('_')} for r in releases],
               'blocks': blocks}
    data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    rc, out = harness.run_subprocess(data)
    ref = json.dumps(reference.response(copy.deepcopy(req)), sort_keys=True)
    got = json.dumps(json.loads(out), sort_keys=True) if out.strip() else ''
    ok = (rc == 0 and got == ref)
    print(('ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), 'case', k, 'rc', rc, 'bytes', len(data))
    if not ok:
        fails += 1
        print(' got', got[:300]); print(' ref', ref[:300])
print('subprocess fails =', fails)
EOF
